escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster poster still, vertical, epic scale, a vast dark cathedral-like space at night): she stands centered in the frame in a WIDE shot, framed from the hips up and SMALL in the frame: the TOP OF HER HAIR is at 40% of the frame height and her face sits between 42% and 50% of it, with a large empty dark area above her head; wearing a sleek, form-fitting BIONIC SUIT in deep navy with matte white armored plates on the shoulders, chest and forearms, thin glowing azure-blue (#0375DB) light seams along the plates; the chest plate is plain, smooth white with NO emblem, NO logo, NO symbol, NO rocket, NO lettering; no watch, no bracelet and no ring, sleek futuristic wraparound glasses with CLEAR TRANSPARENT lenses lightly tinted azure blue, a thin frameless edge and a fine glowing azure line along the top of the lenses; her eyes are clearly visible through the transparent lenses, no mirror reflection covers her eyes. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. She looks straight into the lens with a quiet, confident half-smile. Behind her, receding for hundreds of meters into the darkness, floats an immense field of THOUSANDS of identical thin dark glass cards in endless rows and columns, all unlit, anonymous and barely visible, like every brand nobody sees. From the upper right, OUTSIDE the frame, a WIDE volumetric azure-blue (#0375DB) follow-spot beam cuts diagonally down through thick haze and lands on ONE single card just beside her right shoulder: that card blazes brilliant white with an azure core, lifted forward out of the field, radiating fine glowing particles; its light floods her face and shoulder. The beam enters the frame only below 36% of its height; every other card stays in darkness. The band between 10% and 32% of the frame height is calm, deep dark space with only faint haze, no cards, no beam, no objects. Enormous contrast, no text, no logos of any other brand. We watch from the front row of a dark auditorium: in the lowest fifth, so close to the lens that they dissolve into soft dark shapes, the heads and shoulders of three people of the audience are seen from behind, watching her, outside every light. No desks, no monitors, no plants, no lamps.
